editorial:
Picture a colorful island where six teenage ninjas spend their nights battling monsters and their days just trying to survive high school. That is the fun world of this animated adventure, where you follow a team of young heroes led by Lloyd, a kid who carries a big secret about his family. The movie mixes bright action scenes with silly humor and a surprisingly sweet message about family and growing up. You will see giant robots, wild creatures, and plenty of jokes that land for both kids and adults. The animation looks sharp and playful throughout.

The action moves fast, with big robot fights and chase scenes that keep you entertained. The humor is light and silly, though some jokes feel a bit familiar if you have seen other Lego movies. The story about a son and his villain dad gives the movie real heart, and the voice acting is strong throughout. If you want a fun family night, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final act, Lloyd faces his father Garmadon, who has taken over Ninjago. Instead of a big battle, Lloyd uses a special power to show his dad the truth about their bond. Garmadon turns good and helps save the city. The ninjas win, and Lloyd finally feels accepted by both his team and his father. The movie ends with the group ready for new adventures, showing that family and friendship matter most.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family adventures with humor and heart.
